 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 29 October 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Love, family, commitment and blessings surround you right now. Cancer , you are in your element and you are shining bright. You can see potential and honestly you may even be tasting the life of your dreams in bits and pieces now—and you are loving it. Your outlook has shifted and you are not longer afraid of moving through life with your signature heart on your sleeve and a reverence for whatever you do. Continue on.
 Cosmic tip: Your devotion to whatever you do is your secret ingredient.
